name: Control Room
description: Read-only control room: what waits on you, every agent by product, each product's pull requests and CI, and pings of the sites you list.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: Show a desktop notification once when an agent waits on you or idles past the threshold, or errors, and once when a site you ping goes down or comes back.

settings.title: Repos to watch on the Ship board
settings.description: owner/name, separated by commas. Empty watches every GitHub repo behind your Orca projects.

settings.title: Sites to ping
settings.description: Name=https://url entries, separated by commas or new lines. Each is requested once a minute (5 s timeout, no cookies). Empty: no Sites section and no network requests.
